mapper.select: select nvl(a.cm_volpath,'/') from cmm0031 a, cmm0030 b where a.cm_syscd = #{syscd} and a.cm_syscd = b.cm_syscd and a.cm_svrcd = b.cm_dirbase and a.cm_closedt is null

select '/'||c.cm_deptcd from cmm0030 a, cmm0034 b, cmm0102 c where a.cm_syscd = #{cm_syscd} and b.cm_jobcd = #{cm_jobcd} and substr(a.cm_sysinfo,16,1)='1' and a.cm_syscd = b.cm_syscd and b.cm_jobcd = c.cm_jobcd and b.cm_closedt is null
SELECT cm_path FROM CMM0012 WHERE cm_stno = 'ECAMS' AND cm_pathcd = #{cm_patchcd}
mapper.insert: insert into cmm0070 (CM_SYSCD,CM_DSNCD,CM_DIRPATH,CM_EDITOR,CM_OPENDT,CM_LASTUPDT,CM_RUNSTA) values (#{cm_syscd},#{cm_dsncd},#{cm_dirpath},#{cm_userid}, SYSDATE, SYSDATE, '0')
